# CG-RES-005: Response property added

A property was added to an open response schema.

**Why it matters:** Additions to open schemas were already allowed.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Direction | response |
| Detects | `schema.propertyAdded` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: low · undetermined: low |
| Classification can be overridden | yes |

## Message

> Property "{property}" was added to {where}.
>
> The schema already allowed additional properties, so tolerant consumers are unaffected.
>
> **Fix:** No action needed unless consumers validate responses strictly.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: open schema gains nickname

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {id: {}}}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {id: {}, nickname: {}}}}}}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. Property "nickname" was added to GET /x: response 200 (application/json).

### Fires: gains a required property

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {id: {}}}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, required: [n], properties: {id: {}, n: {}}}}}}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. Property "n" was added to GET /x: response 200 (application/json).

### Fires: strictResponseValidation

With options: `{"policy":{"strictResponseValidation":true,"constraintTightening":"potentially-breaking","responseEnumAdditions":"potentially-breaking","removedRequestParameters":"non-breaking","closedResponseAdditions":"potentially-breaking"}}`

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {id: {}}}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {id: {}, nickname: {}}}}}}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, low. Property "nickname" was added to GET /x: response 200 (application/json).

### Does not fire: request direction

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {id: {}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {id: {}, nickname: {}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
